name: NPO — De Digitale Voorziening (DDV) file delivery (HD)

governance.spec_version: DDV / ketenafspraken (tapeless delivery); version/date not stated in source
governance.source: NPO / Dutch public-broadcasting chain agreements (ketenafspraken) for file-based delivery into De Digitale Voorziening (DDV), operated by NPO, the omroepen and Beeld en Geluid. Primary two-file MXF+metadata spec + DDV core technical spec (BIT-team).
governance.notes: NPO (Nederlandse Publieke Omroep) — PROGRAMME/tapeless route into De Digitale Voorziening (DDV), NOT Ster/Ad Alliance ad-copy. CURRENCY CAVEAT: the located DDV/chain documents date from the tape->file transition era (~2010-2014), are image-based on a DNS-blocked host, and carry no stated version/date — treat as LOW-confidence / needs a current NPO/DDV source to confirm. Video: MXF OP1a, XDCAM HD422 (MPEG-2 Long GOP, GOP 12) 50 Mbit/s, 1920x1080i/50 (25 fps) TFF, 4:2:2, 8-bit, BT.709, limited range (EBU R103 not explicitly cited). Audio: PCM 24-bit/48 kHz; HD MXF must physically carry 8 channels; programme audio stereo on ch1(L)/ch2(R) (2-track or 4-track layout); EBU R128 -23 LUFS +/-0.5 LU, true peak -1 dBTP. Delivery = two files (MXF + identically-named XML metadata; media length must equal metadata length). TC continuous ascending; start value not stated; no bars/slate/leader. Subtitles: separate .890 (EBU/Screen exchange) file; TT888 access-subtitling rules (white/yellow/cyan/green, >=3-frame gap, 165-200 wpm). Metadata XML accompanies MXF (identical basename). PSE not found. Transport: upload to DDV (Mediaset 'compleet' >=2 working days before broadcast); producers certified before first delivery. Language nl, jurisdiction NL.

codec.notes: XDCAM HD422 (MPEG-2 Long GOP, GOP size 12) 50 Mbit/s, 8-bit.

color.notes: ITU-R BT.709 (HDTV). Signal range/legal limits not explicitly cited in the DDV docs.

bit_depth.notes: 8-bit inherent to XDCAM HD422 (not stated verbatim).

track_count.notes: HD MXF must physically carry 8 audio channels. Programme audio delivered as stereo in a 2-track (1 AES pair) or 4-track (2 AES pairs) layout; ch1=Left, ch2=Right.

loudness.notes: Programmaluidheid -23 LUFS +/-0.5 LU (EBU R128); true peak -1 dBTP; max short-term ~ +5 LU.

subtitles.notes: Separate .890 subtitle file (EBU/Screen subtitling exchange), delivered as titelkopie (TIKO) or separate .890 (OWE). TT888 access-subtitling rules: colours white/yellow/cyan/green (red not used), >=3-frame gap, 165-200 wpm.

metadata.notes: XML metadata file accompanies the MXF with an identical basename (differs only by extension); media length must equal metadata length. DDV 'Mediaset' record (MXF designation + MXF-number).

timeline.notes: Continuous, monotonically ascending timecode per the MXF Material Package Timecode Track; start value not stated. No lead-in/lead-out with bars, slate or black; media length equals metadata length exactly.
